note: v505: The iPhone Home Screen icon is the Bookkeeper icon again, matching Android. Your logo was being used as the iOS app icon, which Android could never do (it builds its launcher icon from the app itself), so the two phones showed different icons for the same app. Your logo still shows on invoices, reports, the sidebar and the browser tab. If your iPhone app already has the old icon, remove it from the Home Screen and add it again — iOS locks the icon in when you add the app.
